game.title: Isometry RPG
hud.monsters: {count, plural, =0 {Dungeon cleared! Start a new dungeon to keep fighting.} one {# monster left} other {# monsters left}}
hud.autosave: Progress is saved automatically on this device.
hud.autosaveOff: This browser does not allow saving. Progress will be lost when you close the page.
hud.hint: Move: WASD or arrows. Attack: left mouse button toward the cursor, or Space for the nearest monster. Skills: Q, E, R. Right mouse button: walk to a spot. I: inventory. Walk over loot to pick it up.
skillInfo.heavyBlow: A narrow, far-reaching strike toward the cursor that deals more than double damage.
skillInfo.sweep: A strike that hits every monster around you.
skillInfo.secondWind: Restores about a third of your health at once.
inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.empty: The bag is empty. Monsters drop loot when they die.
log.full: The bag is full. Drop something to pick this up.
log.levelUp: Level {level, number} reached! Health and mana are restored.
log.skillCooling: That skill is not ready yet.
log.skillLocked: That skill opens at level {level, number}.
confirm.newDungeon.title: Start a new dungeon?
confirm.newDungeon.body: The current dungeon will be replaced, and anything left on the floor will be lost. Your hero keeps the level, bag, coins and equipment. The new dungeon will match your hero’s level.
toast.saveDamaged: Your saved game could not be read, so a new dungeon was started.
death.title: You have fallen
death.body: The surviving monsters have returned to their places and recovered. You will rise at the dungeon entrance with full health and mana. Your belongings are safe.
death.xpLost: {count, plural, =0 {You lost no experience.} other {Experience lost: #.}}
error.title: Something went wrong
error.body: The game has stopped. Your progress up to your last stop is safe. Reload the page to continue.
error.bodyNoSave: The game has stopped. Reload the page to start again.
